title: Ecology federal permits record: OPALCO Canoe Island Submarine Cable Replacement (Aquatics 141103)

licence.text: Use allowed with credit and a link; commercial and political use prohibited

rows.label: Project
rows.value: OPALCO Canoe Island Submarine Cable Replacement

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: 2026 - The existing Orcas Power and Light Cooperative (OPALCO) power transmission cable between Shaw Island and Canoe Island would be replaced with a new 2-inch-diameter Kerite (catalog no. 111F15-K1208) 15-kV EPR-insulated power cable with an embedded fiber-optic line. The existing 1-phase 7.2-kV, 2/0 Cu 25-kV XLP-insulated Okanite cable currently providing service to CC was installed in 1967 and is approaching the end of its service life.
